evals.prompt: Run a multi-agent-repo review on the eval fixture at skills/repo/multi-agent-repo/evals/fixtures/minimal-node (README + package.json only — no AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .cursor/rules/). List P1 gaps and write the report under docs/agent-guidelines/ in that fixture — do not edit any other files.
evals.expected_output: Review mode runs parse-mode-args, inventory-agent-setup.sh, score-inventory-gaps.sh, manual rubric pass, produces docs/agent-guidelines/multi-agent-review-<date>.md with P1 gaps L1-01, L2-01, L6-03 at minimum. No implementation changes outside report path.

assertions.name: runs_inventory_script
assertions.description: Output or report references inventory-agent-setup.sh JSON

assertions.name: reports_l1_01
assertions.description: Findings include L1-01 AGENTS.md missing as P1

assertions.name: no_agents_md_created
assertions.description: AGENTS.md was not created in review mode

evals.prompt: multi-agent-repo plan — use the review report at docs/agent-guidelines/multi-agent-review-2026-06-23.md in the current repo. Produce a phased remediation plan with platform-setup steps noted for phases 0–1.
evals.expected_output: Plan mode reads the review doc, groups gaps into phases 0–5, writes docs/agent-guidelines/multi-agent-plan-<date>.md with platform-setup.md approach for AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md generation. Stops without implementing.

assertions.name: platform_setup_phases_0_1
assertions.description: Phases 0–1 reference platform-setup.md or live doc fetch

assertions.name: no_file_implementation
assertions.description: No AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md edits in plan mode

evals.prompt: multi-agent-repo dev on this repo — implement the multi-agent plan: canonical AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md with @AGENTS.md, 000-project.mdc, check-agent-drift.sh, and open a PR on feat/multi-agent-setup. Do not merge.
evals.expected_output: Dev mode creates branch feat/multi-agent-setup, implements phases via platform-setup.md and local scripts, runs check-agent-drift.sh, pushes, returns gh pr create URL. Stops at PR without merging.

assertions.name: pr_opened_not_merged
assertions.description: gh pr create URL returned; merge not performed
